Restoring caller state afterward does not make results independent of those active modes. Root actual5376-question run records192changed answers for subnormal altitude: normal-mode reference0.14999998 versus caller FTZ/DAZ0.14999999. findings.title: Keep the16-item transport bound from rejecting a legal session child list
findings.problem: The hosted Core loop now fatally aborts on the17th terrain ambient child. The original routine walks the entire special-effect list with no such cap, and no invariant enforcing16exists at this list boundary. Existing create_local_sound_effect_entity attaches the supplied subtype to the supplied parent without a session terrain-child count cap; the compiled sound-effect comms receiver uses the same path for its received parent/subtype. Multiple children of a class are valid state (the new kernel test itself exercises duplicates). The ten-child original boot sample establishes that sample, not a universal cardinality limit. A fixed transport array has become a new campaign domain restriction.
